thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH kv-cache-evictions / batch-latency spike in us-east-1 cluster (alerts from canary stack) :rotating_light:
Alex: ack, I'm oncall. seeing 5xx & p99 gen latency up ~3x.
Priya: digging into metrics — KV cache entries jumped from ~12M to ~110M in 18m after the continous-batching rollout. evictions/sec is huge.
Jamal: timeline: batch daemon change deployed ~20m ago that enabled continuous prefix prefill + aggressive batch merging. seems correlated.
Dmitri: logging shows a prefix-prefill flood: many low-cardinality prefixes triggering large kv prefill lists. memory pressure kicked autoscaler.
Alex: customer impact? Sara, can you check product traffic and escalation?
Sara: infra-only so far, but 2 SLO alerts and one customer reported degraded response times (quick auth flow). raising incident page and putting note on status page - "degraded".
Priya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop continuous prefill, 2) reduce max_batch_size and backlog windows, 3) throttle prefill propagation to warmup pipeline.
Alex: +1. Can we roll back the batching config? Jamal, can you push a hotpatch?
Jamal: preparing rollback. Using rollout API to revert the last config revision. command:
```
# rollback batching config
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/configs/rollout \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"service":"kv-batcher","target_revision":"rev-2026-03-01-09"}'
```
Jamal: also going to patch HPA stabilization to prevent thrash while cache drains: increase stabilizationWindow to 180s and set minReplicas=3 temporarily.
Dmitri: while rollback happens, add a short-term KV prefill guard: set PREFILL_MAX_KEYS=2000 and PREFILL_RATE_LIMIT=200/s. command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/kv-batcher PREFILL_MAX_KEYS=2000 PREFILL_RATE_LIMIT=200 --namespace=prod
```
Priya: monitoring - watch kv_cache_entries, evictions/sec, p99 latency, and HPA replica count. I'm posting graphs to the thread.
Alex: Sara please coordinate customer comms: note that we rolled back a config change, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-45m.
Sara: posted to status.redwood.dev, pinged affected CSMs, and updated the incident Slack #customers-cx.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started by Jamal (deploy-ops). watch deploy: https://deploys.redwood.dev/rollouts/9876
Jamal: rollback complete, new config active. starting drain period for kv entries.
Priya: seeing evictions/sec trending down, entries stabilizing ~18m after rollback. p99 gradually falling back.
Dmitri: HPA replicas spiked to 14 during peak. after stabilizationWindow change replicas are settling down to 4-5. looks like the warmup->scale loop caused overshoot.
Alex: followups (postmortem & perf): 1) add a canary guard that prevents continuous prefill when unique-prefix-rate > X, 2) make prefill adaptive to prefix-cardinality, 3) tune HPA to use queue_depth + cpu hybrid metric and longer stabilization for batch churn.
Jamal: opening ENG-4789 for the hotpatch + HPA tweak; adding links to runbook.
oncall-runbook-bot: Runbook referenced: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/kv-batching-incident (steps: isolate batcher, set PREFILL guard, rollback config, HPA stabilization).
Sara: customer impact note: 3rd-party API integrations experienced ~30-60s tail in a small % of calls; one customer support ticket escalated to Tier2. Marking "partial outage" for 35m window in the incident doc.
Priya: logs show a small class of requests with very similar prompt prefixes causing massive dedupe misses -> caused huge prefill fanout. we'll add telemetry to track prefix-cardinality per minute.
Dmitri: added a short-running script to compute top-100 prefixes and their expansion count. will post output in 10m.
Alex: handing off to Priya for next 60m stabilization; I'm rotating off in 20m. Priya please ping if anything regresses.
Priya: ack, I'll keep monitoring and escalate if evictions/sec > 1000 or p99 > 2s.
Sara: final incident update posted. I'll coordinate followup comms with PMs.
incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED by Alex after metrics returned to baseline and rollback confirmed. Duration: ~48m.
Jamal: uploading hotpatch notes and rollback commands to ENG-4789.
Alex: thanks team. postmortem owners: Priya (technical), Sara (customer comms). next steps doc to include: canary thresholds, prefill guards, HPA hybrid metric, and automated rollback if kv_fill_rate > threshold.
Dmitri: FYI - saved heap snapshot and prefills logs to s3://redwood-incidents/2423123456/ for postmortem.
Sara: closing incident in 30m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
